### Learning God's Lessons
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/learning-gods-lessons
Passage: Ezekiel 6:8-9
Points:
- Amid prophetic declarations of judgment, God offers hope by promising that a remnant will survive the sword in exile.
- The hardship of foreign captivity would lead the survivors to remember the Lord and recognize how their idolatry grieved Him.
- God uses the experience of judgment to bring His people to genuine repentance and grief over their rebellion.
- Experiencing covenant discipline proves that God never speaks in vain and that He alone is Lord and Savior.
- True repentance goes beyond eliminating outward idolatry to cultivating wholehearted love for God.
